negative_reviews.author: Somi Shojaee
negative_reviews.text:
I deeply regret choosing your restaurant. The quality of the food was terrible. The female waitress who took our order was extremely rude and showed no respect towards the customers.

What was even more disturbing was the male waiter who was serving the food. His hygiene was absolutely unacceptable. On two separate occasions, I saw him serving food to the table next to mine while he had his hand down the back of his trousers, scratching his backside. It was honestly disgusting and completely inappropriate, especially for someone handling and serving food.

Although the restaurant itself appeared clean, the male waiter serving the food seemed to have no understanding of basic hygiene standards.

I strongly urge the restaurant manager or owner to review the CCTV footage from 20:24 to 20:35 on Saturday, 26 September 2026. You should be able to clearly see what I witnessed, including the waiter putting his hand inside the back of his underwear and scratching himself while working.

Overall, the entire experience was extremely disappointing and unacceptable.

negative_reviews.author: prasenjeet motghare
negative_reviews.text:
Probably applies to takeaway only. Hate to give bad reviews but I think this one is deserved.
I ordered takeaway couple of desserts and when they brought back food- I was told "sorry we don't give ice-cream with takeaway and I don't make rules" and didn't even offer me options to return or money back -so basically I paid 14.40 for small brownie (was dry) and 4 pieces of banana fitters!
I asked if I could get extra tofu in miso soup as my child only eats that (while traveling) and person taking ordered seemed lost. And what l got is half a cup of soup with maybe 4 pieces of tofu- but it was delicious.
It goes downhill from that- I asked if goyzo can be steamed instead of pan fried (which is standard across world/countries I have tried- and again explained that that is how my child eat it. Anyone who has kids may understand). I was told,"No changes in menu" and he snatched menu and said, "you done ordering "?
Oh well. Seat in looked good- and suchi looked good BUT I left felt cheated!

negative_reviews.author: Muhra
negative_reviews.text:
The atmosphere was good, although nothing special. The food was served quickly and tasted good, but wasn’t outstanding.

Overall, it was a decent experience, but probably not somewhere I would visit again.

deliveroo.source: Deliveroo Weekly Dash PDF overview (Sales Overview) — gap-site weekly sales; ops metrics not in this source. + ops from Weekly Summary sheet

issues: Sales were 50,864.83 against a 45,500 target, 5,364.83 (+11.79%) ahead, and 4,063.65 up on the same week in 2025.
Covers fell to 2,108 from 2,161 year on year (-2.45%) and spend per head fell to 23.79 from 24.60 (-3.29%).
Operational labour was 20.25% (10,298.22) against a 22% target, with the all-in figure at 23.24% (11,820.37) from 709.27 hours.
Drinks mix was 15.13%, sushi 16.20% and sides 14.99%.
Food variance was -0.4% and drinks variance was 0.3%.
Google reviews for the week were five 5 star, one 4 star, one 3 star and two 1 star, and the site needs better reviews to regain its 4.8 rating.
Both 1 star reviews came from one customer reporting a serious personal hygiene incident involving a team member, treated as a red light issue.
The team member involved has been identified via CCTV and the GM will hold a serious conversation about professional conduct.
Some lower ratings were put down to staff training gaps, and extra training is being given on FOH.
The weekly hygiene compliance score was low again and inconsistent, needing more focus from the management team.
Two FOH team members, Heather and Jules, have resigned, Jules with immediate effect, putting strain on the rota.
The Head Chef is on holiday from 29/09, returning on 20/10.
Out of stock items remain an issue, and the GM is liaising with Matt J so drinks are ordered when needed rather than cut.
The GM Maki tour is complete and drove a large uptake in app sign ups across Scotland and Newcastle.
Information has been received on the November book tour and its operational impact is still to be discussed.
No new maintenance updates were reported since the previous KPI report.
actions: Hold a professional conduct conversation with the team member identified via CCTV - Owner: Scott Renwick (06/10/2026)
Brief staff on hygiene and customer facing standards and lift weekly hygiene compliance - Owner: Scott Renwick (06/10/2026)
Finalise the hiring and promotion plan for the FOH vacancies with AM approval - Owner: Scott Renwick (06/10/2026)
Agree drinks ordering with Matt J to stop out of stock items - Owner: Scott Renwick (06/10/2026)
Discuss the operational impact of the November book tour - Owner: M8 (06/10/2026)
